## Milestone
M{N} — {Name}

## Product Goal
What can a user *do* after this ships that they couldn't before? Write it as a
one-sentence story from the user's perspective, not the system's. This is the
yardstick the PR is measured against — if the change satisfies acceptance
criteria but the product goal isn't reachable through the UI, the issue is not
done.

Example: "As a household owner, I can invite a second person by email and see
them appear in the members list once they accept."

Bad example (system perspective): "Add POST /households/:id/invites endpoint."

What explicitly NOT to do.
